title: Quintessential Juicy Indian Tofu Korma
description: A cultured and adventurous Indian dish featuring sansho and mortar-pestle-pound techniques, this vegan-friendly korma is a must-try for any food enthusiast, with a perfect balance of juicy tofu and rich flavors.
instructions: In a mortar, pound the toasted coriander seeds and cumin seeds into a fine powder.
In a large pan, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat and fry the tofu until golden brown.
Remove the tofu from the pan and set aside, then add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil.
Add the ground sansho pepper and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the powdered coriander and cumin seeds and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the coconut milk, diced tomatoes, and lemon juice, and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the korma simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the fried tofu back into the pan and stir to coat with the korma sauce.
Season with salt to taste, then garnish with chopped cilantro and serve over rice or with naan bread.
